subject: Drop WRITE flag from pausetest timer commands to shorten test sleeps (#4817)
reason: The change modifies only Valkey's own test assets: tests/modules/pausetest.c (dropping the 'write' flag from the PAUSETEST.TIMER_* commands of the test-only pausetest module) and the pausetest.tcl test, so the pause can be set before scheduling the timer and the timer delay shortened from 100ms to 1ms. No server source changes: the module-write-during-pause rejection paths in src/module.c (isPausedActions checks in VM_Call/VM_Replicate/VM_ReplicateVerbatim) are identical in the parent and the change, and tests/modules binaries are not shipped.
